title: Choose the new Avenor About page
question: Which composition best explains what Avenor is, why it exists, and who is behind it?

options.label: A Letter from Avenor
options.lineage: editorial founder's letter and literary colophon
options.thesis: Avenor introduces itself through one confident editorial statement, then lets its mission and people sign the story.
options.viewport: An oversized statement occupies the left of the first viewport while the mentor portrait and a compact mission note anchor the right.
options.risk: It becomes too literary if the team and contact path are not unmistakably practical.

options.label: Connected by Books
options.lineage: annotated relationship map and cultural atlas
options.thesis: Avenor is explained as a visible network connecting readers, books, mission, and the people who maintain it.
options.viewport: The first viewport is a composed relationship map with Avenor at its center and mission, vision, discovery, and team branching outward.
options.risk: The diagram can feel technical unless the human portraits remain emotionally dominant.

options.label: The Studio Journal
options.lineage: independent literary journal and documentary contact sheet
options.thesis: Avenor reads like a living issue assembled by its team: purpose first, then the people, process, and invitation to participate.
options.viewport: A magazine-like opening spread pairs a sharp Avenor manifesto with a staggered contact sheet of the mentor and members.
options.risk: Dense editorial pacing must be carefully simplified on mobile.
